risk_if_not_implemented: Without Incident Tracking Repository, security incidents may not be detected, contained, investigated or communicated in a timely manner, increasing their scope, duration and cost. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Inability to Demonstrate Due Diligence / Due Care (R-GV-9), Loss of Investigative / Evidentiary Capability (R-IR-1), Incident Persistence / Recurrence (R-IR-3), and most likely increases susceptibility to Human Error (MT-9).

compensating_control_1.name: Threat Intelligence Feeds
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to maintain situational awareness of vulnerabilities and evolving threats by leveraging the knowledge of attacker tactics, techniques and procedures to facilitate the implementation of preventative and compensating controls.
compensating_control_1.justification: Threat Intelligence Feeds (THR-04) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Incident Tracking Repository (IRO-17) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Process applicability. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Situational Awareness For Incidents
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to document, monitor and report the status of cybersecurity and data protection incidents to internal stakeholders all the way through the resolution of the incident.
compensating_control_2.justification: Situational Awareness For Incidents (IRO-16.1) provides personnel training and awareness that compensates for the absence of Incident Tracking Repository (IRO-17) by reducing human-factor risk by equipping personnel to recognize and respond to relevant threats. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
